pose: Full side profile of a sturdy Kentrosaurus. Small plates are visible on the neck, transitioning into long, sharp pairs of spikes over the hips and down the tail. The head, spine, and spiked tail are held in a perfectly straight horizontal line to show maximum body length. Energetic expression with a soulful smirk. Muscular, pillar-like legs firmly planted. 30% negative space buffers above and below to ensure the vertical spikes are not clipped in a 17:7 crop.
